name: CaseAI – Click to Chat
author: manpreet2527

sections.description:
Stop losing customers because you couldn’t reply instantly. CaseAI – Click to Chat adds a beautiful, mobile-responsive chat button to your WordPress site in seconds.

Visitors can click the button to open WhatsApp on their phone or desktop and message you directly.

FREE FEATURES:
* Instant Connection: Redirects users to WhatsApp App (Mobile) or WhatsApp Web (Desktop) automatically.
* Custom Number: Works with any personal or business WhatsApp number.
* Lightweight: Zero impact on your site speed.
* No Coding: Simple settings page to enter your number and go.
* Clean Design: A professional floating button that looks great on any theme.

External Services

This plugin connects to external third-party services to enable the WhatsApp chat button functionality.

WhatsApp / Meta

When a visitor clicks the chat button, they are redirected to one of the following WhatsApp URLs (no data is sent by the plugin itself — the redirect happens in the user’s browser):

  • Mobile: https://wa.me/ — Opens the WhatsApp app on mobile devices.
  • Desktop: https://web.whatsapp.com/send — Opens WhatsApp Web on desktop browsers.

The phone number you enter in the plugin settings is appended to these URLs client-side. No data is transmitted to Anthropic, CaseAI servers, or any other party by this plugin.

  • WhatsApp Terms of Service: https://www.whatsapp.com/legal/terms-of-service
  • WhatsApp Privacy Policy: https://www.whatsapp.com/legal/privacy-policy
  • Meta Privacy Policy: https://www.facebook.com/privacy/policy/
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress.
  3. Go to Settings -> CaseAI Chat to enter your WhatsApp number.
  4. Click Save. The widget is now live!
sections.faq:
Does this plugin include branding?

By default, the plugin is unbranded. You can optionally check the “Show Powered by CaseAI” box in the settings to support our development, but this is completely up to you!
